question: Do detection-oriented candidate selection and positive assignment miss available segmentation-quality positions in official pretrained YOLO26m-seg?
model: official COCO pretrained yolo26m-seg.pt; Ultralytics 8.4.100; no fine-tuning

phase1.data: all 5000 COCO val2017 images; all original annotations; crowd retained for COCOeval
phase1.mask_export: official input-grid process_mask, then validator-style binary scale and byte; empty masks omitted by original exporter
phase1.evaluation: concatenate original zero-threshold prediction lists and recompute COCOeval segm; never average AP; cached predictions lack native bbox so no full Box AP claim
phase1.structure: existing confidence-ordered unique same-class Box50 slots; Box75/Mask75 split; unmatched original GT retained; distinct from official segm matches
phase1.error_budget: coverage TP/G below .75 needs own-pixel recovery; coverage at least .75 admits ideal FP removal; neither identifies network cause
phase1.candidate_opportunity: best same-class exported mask per GT; also maximum bipartite Mask75 matching to account for competition; these are diagnostic opportunities, not deployment gains

phase2.sample: 32 randomly selected unique-image Box75-good Mask75-bad slots plus 32 nearest same-class log-area successful controls; seed 20260916; preserve all GT competitors in each image
phase2.forward: batch1, FP32, imgsz640 stride32 auto-letterbox; frozen eval model, both raw branches available; one2one primary
phase2.assignment: reuse native TaskAlignedAssigner via v8DetectionLoss; one2many topk10; one2one topk7 topk2=1; replay on all original noncrowd COCO boxes in input coordinates, not historical augmented training assignment
phase2.candidate_pool: per GT union native assigned positions, top 32 box-IoU positions, top 32 GT-class-score positions among BoxIoU>=.5, and exact retained one2one slot; pool-bounded best only
phase2.mask_comparison: native predicted box crop and common fixed retained-box crop; shared prototype and decoder; chunk8
phase2.metrics: selected/best-box/best-mask/best-own-assigned Mask IoU, Mask75 recovery, native assignment ownership, GT score, scale, fixed-crop residual advantage
phase2.limitations: GT-assisted diagnosis; one model; COCO val previously explored; no proof of historical gradient starvation or causal training error; no new training in this study
